operations.title: Finite monodromy has a complete exponent-controlled power spectrum
operations.statement: For a faithful action of a finite group H on F_p^r, the power operation on F_p^r semidirect H commutes with all coefficient fiber sums and basis-level fiber lifts iff gcd(n,p*exp(H))=1.
operations.scope: Elementary-abelian kernel; arbitrary finite quotient; basis-level power correspondence, not necessarily a ring Adams operation; no physical chain transfer.

operations.title: Nonabelian and noncyclic finite-monodromy spectrum test
operations.protocol: Exhaust n=1..24 and every acting element for faithful S3 on F5^2 and faithful V4 on F3^2; compare to gcd(n,p*exp(H))=1.
operations.falsifier: Any fiber/index disagrees with the exponent criterion.

operations.title: Finite-monodromy exponent Adams spectrum research packet

operations.outcome: pass: faithful S3 and V4 actions agree with gcd(n,p*exp(H))=1 across 48 index cases and 97776 exact checks

evidence.paraphrase: Exact nonabelian and noncyclic survivor spectra match the exponent theorem.
